links.outcome: Factual accuracy (RadGraph F1) of AI-generated chest x-ray report Findings versus reference reports
links.effect: Mean RadGraph F1 was 0.251 (95% CI, 0.245-0.257), indicating substantially imperfect structural correctness; BERTScore-F1 0.498; CheXbert cosine similarity 0.394.
links.quote: Mean RadGraph F1 was 0.251 (95% CI, 0.245-0.257), indicating substantially imperfect structural correctness.

links.outcome: Whether surface semantic similarity of Impressions reflects Findings-level entity-relation fidelity
links.effect: Weak positive association (coefficient 0.154; 95% CI 0.124-0.183), attenuating with longer Impressions; fluent Impressions gave little assurance that Findings were factually correct.
links.quote: A weak positive association existed between semantic similarity and entity-relation fidelity (coefficient 0.154; 95% CI, 0.124-0.183), and this association attenuated substantially with longer Impressions.

screen.reason: Evaluates factual accuracy and clinical fidelity metrics of a vision-language model (RadVLM) for chest X-ray report generation on a public benchmark dataset without testing a specific deployment intervention.
